== Notes ==
* This skill reduces all types of damage, including [[armor-ignoring damage]].
* This is a popular damage reduction skill for [[farming]], sometimes coupled with [[Protective Spirit]] (cast before Stoneflesh Aura) with less than 330 health, to ensure losing no health at all. This build is known as the 330Hp, similarly to the [[600]] and [[55 Monk]] build.
* When removed with a damaging [[List of enchantment removal skills|removal skill]], such as [[Shatter Enchantment]], the damage from the removal will still be reduced.
* This skill can be particularly effective against [[Assassin]]s, as many of their builds deal much of their damage through critical hits and rely on them for energy management.
{{Bug|This enchantment does not actually make you immune to critical hits, but prevents extra damage from them. As such, effects that may result from them, such as [[knock down]], or the re-applying effect of [[Critical Agility]] and [[Critical Defenses]] will still apply. However, the damage-nullified critical hit will not trigger the energy gain of [[Critical Strikes]].}}
